info.description:
LogicMonitor is a SaaS-based infrastructure performance monitoring platform providing full-stack observability for hybrid cloud, on-premises, and network environments.

Authentication: Bearer token in the Authorization header — generate an API token from LogicMonitor Settings → Users and Roles → API Tokens (or via the admin API tokens endpoint).

Source: https://www.logicmonitor.com/support/rest-api-developers-guide
info.title: LogicMonitor
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 62 of 353 upstream operations covering common CRUD for automation: monitored devices and device groups (with custom properties), website (service) monitors and monitor groups, alert acknowledgement/escalation/notes, scheduled downtime (SDT), and collector/collector-group management. See the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.

Specifies the v3 Uptime Device request type. Supported values:
 uptimewebcheck - for Uptime Web Check devices
 uptimepingcheck - for Uptime Ping Check devices blank/empty value- for regular devices

NimbleUptime-

The values can be true|false where
